  MEDIUM   F1   sshd is open to any source on 22/tcp                                              -2
                IPv4: accepted by filter/ufw-user-limit-accept rule #1. Limited by: rate limit.
                filter/ufw-user-limit-accept #1:  -j ACCEPT
                  reached by INPUT #2 → ufw-before-input #13 → ufw-user-input #3
                fix  ufw manages this rule, and a change made with iptables is lost at its next
                     reload. If the clients are known, allow only them and delete the open rule.
                     Allow the known clients:
                       ufw allow from <trusted-cidr> to any port 22 proto tcp
                     Delete the rule for any source:
                       ufw delete limit 22/tcp
